# Frequently asked questions

## Do I need to install anything?

No. Pantry works in your web browser, on a computer or a phone.

## Can I use Pantry on my phone in the shop?

Yes. Open Pantry in your phone's browser and sign in. Each time you press
**Mark bought**, the page updates straight away.

## Why don't I see changes someone else just made?

Pantry shows the list as it was when you opened the page. Reload the page to
see what others have added or ticked off since.

## Can I stop sharing a list?

Not yet: Pantry doesn't have a way to stop sharing a list once it's shared.
If you need to, make a new list and share it only with the people you want.

## Can I move items from one list to another?

Not at the moment. Add the item to the other list and delete it from the
first.

## Is there a limit to how many lists or items I can have?

No limit on lists or items. List and item names can be up to 80 characters,
and quantities go up to 999.

## Can two people share the same account?

It's better for each person to have their own account and share lists
between them: everyone sees the same list, and Pantry shows who shared what.

## Someone shared a list with me, but I can't find it

Lists shared with you are on **Your lists**, under **Shared with me**. If it
isn't there, check with the person who shared it that they used the email you
sign in with.

## Who do I ask for help?

Ask whoever runs Pantry for your household, or ask in your support channel.
